name: Urine Raman spectra, diabetes mellitus and renal pathologies
citation: Senger R.S., Robertson J.L., Kavuru V., Choudhury D. (2022) Raman spectra of urine from patients with diabetes mellitus and other pathologies. Zenodo. doi:10.5281/zenodo.7343559. Analysis: Kavuru V. et al. (2023) PeerJ 11:e14879, doi:10.7717/peerj.14879.
instrument: Agiltron PeakSeeker PRO-785, bulk liquid, 30 mW, 30 s, 8 cm-1 resolution
processing: Median of replicate scans, cropped to 400-1800 cm-1, linearly resampled to 2 cm-1; no other change.
caveat: All DM+ and DM- patients have chronic kidney disease; group differences may reflect kidney disease, medication, diet or collection conditions as well as diabetes.
